question: Indian Foreign Services and Indian Revenue Services come under which type of Civil Service?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Central services**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Indian Foreign Services (IFS) and Indian Revenue Services (IRS) are classified as **Central services**.
 
• These services come under the umbrella of the Indian Civil Services, which are managed by the **Union Government of India**.
 
• Central services are responsible for the administration of the central government departments and policies in various fields.
 
• Officers of Central Services are recruited through the Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) examination.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Indian Foreign Service (IFS)**

 
 
• The IFS is a Central Service and a premier diplomatic service of India responsible for managing India's foreign relations.
 
• IFS officers represent India in its embassies, high commissions, consulates, and permanent missions to international organizations.
 
• They handle India’s external affairs, including diplomacy, trade, and cultural relations.
 
• Recruitment for IFS officers is through the Civil Services Examination conducted by the UPSC.
 
 
 
• **Indian Revenue Service (IRS)**
 
 
• The IRS is another Central Service responsible for the collection and administration of the various direct and indirect taxes accruing to the Government of India.
 
• It is divided into two branches: IRS (Income Tax) and IRS (Customs and Central Excise).
 
• IRS officers are involved in the formulation and enforcement of the taxation policies in India.
 
• Like the IFS, IRS officers are also recruited through the Civil Services Examination conducted by the UPSC.
 
 
 
• **Union Public Service Commission (UPSC)**
 
 
• The UPSC is India's central agency authorized to conduct various examinations for appointment to the services of the Union.
 
• It conducts the Civil Services Examination, Engineering Services Examination, Combined Defence Services Examination, and several other examinations.
 
• The UPSC plays a critical role in ensuring a merit-based and transparent recruitment process for various central services.
